hypothesis: On real cached LIBERO windows, the pinned StarWAM ActionDiT conditioned on frozen standalone INT8-H3 last-layer observation features produces finite non-zero gradients in the action expert, feature projector and proprio encoder, performs a non-zero optimizer update, and restores an identical probe prediction from an atomic checkpoint.
single_variable: Replace StarWAM's online trainable Wan2.2 observation feature extractor with frozen cached standalone MiniMax-H3 INT8 layer-49 features while retaining its ActionDiT source, 32-step min/max-normalized action contract and shift-5 weighted flow objective.
parent_baseline: StarWAM feature-conditioned Wan2.2 recipe at commit cd76d96f273f81e228a05f40f9697fe2514e2356; this is a mechanical backbone-port canary and does not claim an action-quality comparison.

references.title: Fast-WAM: Can Video Generation Models Act as World-Action Models?
fastwam_deploy standalone INT8-H3 StarWAM action trainer
references.revision: dab8058 plus uncommitted trainer, launcher, tests and dossier diff

architecture.paper: Independent action diffusion transformer conditioned on world-model features.
architecture.upstream_code: Byte-pinned StarWAM modules/action_dit.py and wan_block.py; official LIBERO feature recipe uses hidden 1024, random ActionDiT initialization, 32 actions and the backbone layer count.
architecture.local: Imports the pinned ActionDiT source with enforced SHA256; the production spec is 30 layers, hidden 1024, FFN 4096, 40 heads x 128 dimensions.
architecture.rationale: The two executed upstream source files are hash checked before construction.

architecture.upstream_code: Online Wan2.2 observation forward with feature_condition_train_backbone=true.
architecture.local: Frozen standalone INT8 MiniMax-H3 layer 49, pooled to 32 tokens before training and read from cache; H3 receives no gradient.
architecture.rationale: This is explicitly an action-only-on-frozen-features backbone port; it tests whether H3 observation features can drive the pinned action carrier without conflating H3 fine-tuning.

data.field: LIBERO window and feature cache contract
data.upstream_code: Two-camera LIBERO, 33 frames and 32 actions with current observation features pooled by adaptive_avg_pool1d to 32 tokens.
data.local: 277713 uniform unique frame-indexed windows from 1712 episodes and 40 tasks; last32 cache requires layer49, timestep1, observation-only rows, exact pooling metadata and text-only context.
data.rationale: The action span and adaptive feature pooling match; H3's latent packing and text encoder are backbone-specific deviations recorded separately.

data.paper: Held-out evaluation is required for method claims.
data.upstream_code: Training and evaluation are separate and rollout uses fixed LIBERO states.
data.local: The current v8 candidate has zero validation episodes; this canary checks mechanics and restore only.
data.rationale: No effect or generalization conclusion is allowed; a non-empty episode-disjoint validation manifest is required before GO_LONG effectiveness work.

action.upstream_code: Seven-dimensional 32-step LIBERO action chunk and eight-dimensional proprio, min/max mapped to [-1,1] with outliers clipped to [-5,5].
action.local: Same shapes and StarWAM min/max formula using train-only v8 stats; pad tokens are masked from weighted flow loss.
action.rationale: The local loader reproduces upstream normalization and applies the real action_is_pad mask.

objective.paper: Continuous flow matching for action generation.
objective.upstream_code: Shift-5 scheduler, x_t=(1-sigma)x_0+sigma*noise, target=noise-x_0 and timestep-weighted masked MSE.
objective.local: Directly imports the pinned StarWAM FlowMatchScheduler and flow_matching_loss with shift5.
objective.rationale: No local reinterpretation of sigma, velocity target or weighting is used.

optimization.paper: Full training requires a substantial multi-epoch budget.
optimization.upstream_code: AdamW betas(0.9,0.95), LR1e-4, WD0.01, BF16, grad clip1; official feature recipe trains 50 epochs with warmup1000.
optimization.local: Same optimizer constants and BF16; two-layer mechanical canary uses two optimizer steps on two GPUs, then production 30-layer uses one optimizer step only.
optimization.rationale: The bounded budget tests memory, gradients, update and restore, not convergence.

evaluation.paper: Closed-loop LIBERO success is the final policy metric.
evaluation.upstream_code: Fixed LIBERO rollout plus offline action metrics.
evaluation.local: Finite non-constant output, non-zero action/projector/proprio gradients, non-zero optimizer delta and exact fresh-process checkpoint restore on a deterministic real cached sample.
evaluation.rationale: This is the precondition for an evaluable policy; it is not a policy-quality or closed-loop result.

decision.rationale: The source, architecture, data, action, objective, optimization and mechanical evaluation contracts are fixed and unit gradient tests pass. Authorize only the two-layer two-step real cached-feature canary; production 30-layer may run one optimizer step and restore only after the small-depth path is finite.
